outcome: `flask run` binds correctly when SERVER_NAME holds a bracketed IPv6 address rather than treating the first colon as the port separator

acceptance_criteria.text: A SERVER_NAME holding a bracketed IPv6 address yields the address as the host and no port, rather than splitting at the first colon inside the address.

expected_verification.assertion: running with SERVER_NAME set to a bracketed IPv6 address and no explicit port binds that address

acceptance_criteria.text: An ordinary host:port SERVER_NAME still yields the same host and port it did before, including the port-zero case.

expected_verification.assertion: the existing host/port parametrisation still passes, port 0 included
